breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the uniform load by its single resultant for an exact deflection calculation, but equivalent resultants preserve force and moment, not the full beam-deflection response.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats and amplifies the error by instructing to replace the UDL with a single concentrated force at midspan (P = wL = 1500 N at x = 500 mm), and even provides numerical results based on this incorrect model. The ground truth requires using the actual UDL formulas (θ = wL³/6EI, v = wL⁴/8EI) for exact results. The agent failed to recognize that the resultant-force substitution does not preserve the beam deflection response and instead treated the flawed approach as correct.
